rows.why_great: A two-storey wooden house built in July 2009 in Higashi-Mishima, Nasushiobara, in northern Tochigi. 97.9 m² with three bedrooms and a living, dining and kitchen room, balconies on both floors and storage in every room, on a 192 m² freehold plot with parking for two cars. The seller has just renewed the wallpaper, cleaned the kitchen and bathrooms and changed the locks, and the empty house can be handed over at once. A primary school is 600 m away and a supermarket 450 m. The buyer must fit a new water heater. Asking ¥18,290,000 (about €104,600).

rows.title: Well-kept 1899 house with a new double garage near Chester Park in Duluth
rows.why_great: Asking US$255,000 (about €232,400) for a house of about 148 m² in Duluth, the hilly port city on Lake Superior. Built in 1899, it has had its furnace, roof, windows, siding, doors, wiring and plumbing all replaced since 2011. Downstairs are spacious living and dining rooms with hardwood floors, a white kitchen with stainless appliances and a door to the back deck, and a half bath with laundry. The three bedrooms and an updated full bathroom are upstairs. There is a newer two-car garage plus an extra parking space, and Chester Park and downtown are close. Yearly property tax US$3,368, no HOA fee.

rows.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom village house with fireplace in Lacombe, Languedoc
rows.why_great: This fully renovated village house in Lacombe provides 85 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a living area with a kitchen space, the first floor has two bedrooms and a shower room, and the attic on the second floor could be a third bedroom, office or leisure room. It has a fireplace and wood-burning stove, exposed stone, wooden floors and beams. The lakes of Galaube, Lampy and Laprade are a few minutes away, and the house is on mains drainage with fibre-optic broadband. Asking €99,000, about €1,165/m².

rows.title: Renovated country house with panoramic porch and olive grove near Arpino, Lazio
rows.why_great: A recently renovated single-storey country house on the hills around Arpino, within walking distance of the historic town. The photos show new bathrooms, white walls, wood floors and a large covered porch with a beamed wooden roof looking over olive trees and mountains. It has a fireplace, a pellet stove, air conditioning, new double glazing and metal shutters, plus a cellar. The garden around the house is fenced and gated, and the plot of about 11,751 m2 is planted with olives. About 147 m2 for 180,000 euros, under 1,250 euros per m2.

rows.title: Renovated village house with energy rating B in the centre of Riez, Verdon
rows.why_great: A 91 m2 village house on a small square in the centre of Riez, fully renovated to current standards and rated B for energy, which is rare for an old Provençal house. It has two kitchens and living areas over the lower floors, two bedrooms (one with its own shower), a bathroom, reversible air conditioning in three zones and about 50 m2 of cellars. A small courtyard behind a wrought iron gate fits a table. Shops, schools, a hospital and two weekly markets are in the village, and Lake Sainte-Croix and the Verdon gorges are minutes away. About 1,750 euros per m2.

rows.title: Renovated red wooden villa with wide valley views near Fränsta, Västernorrland
rows.why_great: Asking 750,000 SEK (about €68,000) for a 116 m² two-storey wooden house from 1915 on a 2,820 m² plot, under €600 per m². The advert says you can move straight in: kitchen, bathroom and surfaces were renovated in 2016, the wiring was recently updated and fibre broadband is connected. Downstairs are a kitchen with island and old wood stove, a dining room, a living room with fireplace and a tiled stove, and a shower room. Upstairs are two bedrooms. A garage and barn give storage, and the house looks out over a wide green valley. Running costs 36,085 SEK a year.

rows.title: Restored 2-bedroom house with barn and garden in Chef-Boutonne, Deux-Sèvres, Poitou-Charentes
rows.why_great: Restored house with a welcoming cottage feel, set over two floors. Two bright reception rooms, a galley kitchen, a downstairs WC, a bathroom and two bedrooms. A spacious barn with a former cattle shed, a garden with established trees and plants, and a garden storage outbuilding, plus 13,670 sq ft of land. A concealed storage area connects the house to the barn. Electric heating. Asking €101,750, about €1,131/m².

rows.title: Renovated furnished cottage on 860 m2 of land in Lajes do Pico, Azores
rows.why_great: A fully renovated stone cottage in Silveira, 3 km from the old whaling town of Lajes on Pico island, sold furnished and equipped. 84 m2 of built area on two floors with a bedroom, living room, new fitted kitchen and modern shower room, plus air conditioning and fibre internet. Energy class C. It stands on 860 m2 of land with parking and fruit trees, all classed as urban, and the advert says about 388 m2 more could be built subject to permission. School 1 km away, Pico airport 30 minutes. Only one bedroom.

rows.title: Detached house with a 350 m2 garden and garage in San Lorenzo in Campo, Marche
rows.why_great: An early 1900s detached house in the centre of San Lorenzo in Campo, a hill village in Pesaro and Urbino province, about 25 km from the Marotta beaches. The renovated, furnished first floor (65 m2) has a kitchen with dining area, two bedrooms and a bathroom; the ground floor (65 m2) holds a garage and two storage rooms. The owner lists wall and ceiling insulation, new floors, exterior painting and certified wiring, plumbing and boiler. A fenced south-facing garden of about 350 m2, a covered pergola and a carport. Pharmacy, shops and schools are a short walk away.

rows.title: Move-in ready 1700s stone village house of 180 m² near La Rochefoucauld, Charente
rows.why_great: About 180 m² of old stone house for €189,000, roughly €1,050 per m², and the advert says it is ready to move into. The ground floor has three rooms of over 30 m² each: a living room, a large beamed kitchen and a bedroom with its own bathroom, so you can live on one level. Upstairs are a 34 m² bedroom with a private bathroom, a 23 m² office, a mezzanine and a terrace. Exposed stone, old beams and stoves. Small easy garden, carport and workshop. The village is 5 km from La Rochefoucauld and 30 km from Angoulême TGV station. Energy rating D.

rows.title: Renovated family house with garden and cellar in Clamecy, Nièvre, Burgundy
rows.why_great: This renovated house in Clamecy is move-in ready, with new windows and doors, updated decor and fresh paintwork. The ground floor has a bright living room, a separate kitchen with direct garden access and a WC, and upstairs are three bedrooms and a bathroom. Outdoors there is about 105 m2 of garden on a 180 m2 plot, facing east and west, plus a cellar of over 30 m2. Heating is electric, and shops, schools and the train station are nearby. Asking €79,000, about €681/m².

rows.title: Two-storey stone house facing the Libyan Sea in Koutsounari, south Crete
rows.why_great: A two-storey stone house with open views of the Libyan Sea, 1.3 km from Long Beach on the south coast of Crete. A stone-paved courtyard under a pergola faces the sea, and inside stairs lead up to a large view terrace. The living room has wood beams and a fireplace, and there is a separate traditional kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, all tiled. Hot water comes from a solar panel, and there is parking outside. Shops and tavernas open all year are a 3-minute drive away. About 88 m2 for 195,000 euros.

rows.title: Updated 1886 house with a fenced garden and an oversized garage in La Crosse, Wisconsin
rows.why_great: Asking US$214,900 (about €195,800) for a three-bedroom house of about 142 m² in La Crosse, a university city on the Mississippi in western Wisconsin. Built in 1886, it has had recent updates: fresh paint in many rooms, new central air conditioning, a new water heater and a new deck. The front opens into a bright enclosed porch room, and the galley kitchen has wood-look floors and plenty of cupboards. The fully fenced back garden is neatly landscaped, with a patio and fire pit, and the oversized garage holds three or more cars plus storage. One bathroom. Yearly property tax US$3,565, no HOA fee.

rows.title: Cottage-style house with a new kitchen near the waterfront in Pictou, Nova Scotia
rows.why_great: Asking C$199,900 (about €127,100) for a white cottage-style house of about 132 m² in the heart of Pictou, a historic harbour town on the Northumberland Strait. The kitchen is brand new, with white units, wood counters and an island, and opens to a bright dining room with exposed beams. There is a large bathroom with laundry on the ground floor, and three bedrooms plus an office upstairs. The fenced back garden has a big new deck, a shed and a wired workshop. Downtown shops, cafes, the marina and the waterfront are a few steps away.

rows.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom house with river views and terrace in Brigueil-le-Chantre, Vienne

The kitchen/diner, lounge and shower room are on the ground floor, with an office/TV room and master bedroom with en suite above. A small sunny terrace overlooks the river, and a large garage at street level offers storage and space for a small car. A wooded plot of land is a short walk away, close to the river. Heating is electric, and amenities are within 20 minutes. Asking €75,000, about €962/m².

Downstairs is a bright living room with an open modern kitchen and a guest toilet, upstairs two bedrooms and a full bathroom. The private rear terrace garden opens towards the communal pool, which the advert says was recently renovated and has showers and toilets. Described as in excellent condition and ready to move into. Community fees are not stated in the advert, so ask before making an offer.

It has a small private courtyard, double glazing and radiators on town gas. The upper floor has its own street door. Energy class G.

There is 624 sq ft of land but no garden, and fishing, walking and cycling spots are nearby. The house has electric heating and mains drainage, and Confolens is 10 minutes away. Asking €59,950, about €821/m².

It was completely renovated in 2025 and 2026: new water pipes, bathrooms, windows, doors, floors and tiles, and all the electrics redone. New radiators, infrared panels and a new Swedish stove. Kitchen and dining room, two bedrooms and a WC on the ground floor, a large living room upstairs, and a cellar with a bathroom. About 170 m² of flat garden. Ready to move into. Asking €149,000, about €993/m², after a price cut.

Maintenance fee not stated.

rows.why_great: This townhouse in good condition sits in the historic centre of Tournus, within walking distance of all amenities. The ground floor has a living and dining room, a fitted kitchen, a small covered outdoor area under a glass roof, a laundry area and a separate toilet, while the first floor has a bedroom and a shower room with toilet. A second bedroom sits above a landing and office area with a Velux roof window. Mains gas heating with a recent boiler also provides hot water, and the windows are double glazed. Asking €89,000, about €1,112/m².

Electrics redone, full insulation carried out in 2011, double glazing, mains gas heating, mains drainage and fibre available. Asking €119,500, about €766/m². The property has a private fully enclosed garden with a pond and an additional outbuilding, plus a substantial barn across the quiet road with electricity and water connected. Oil-fired central heating is installed. Verteuil-sur-Charente, the nearby market town, is within easy reach. Asking €120,000, about €1,143/m².

It is one of two lots in a small co-ownership with no running charges, as stated in the advert. Asking €139,000, about €927/m², which is low for a renovated house of this size in the Dordogne.

A timber staircase leads to a double bedroom and a shower room below a pitched wooden ceiling. A small private garden looks straight down on the lake and Monte Isola, and a single garage is included. The main home has vaulted ceilings, a kitchen with a dining room, a living room with a fireplace, further bedrooms and bathrooms, and balconies looking over the valley. A covered terrace at the entrance faces the village and the mountains. Furnished and lived in, with several entrances. The Sirente-Velino park starts at the edge of the village. A guest room has a private shower room, and the master suite has exposed beams. Outside, a courtyard of 27 m2 has a terrace and storage shed, with a garden and land of 291 sq ft. Heating is electric and the village has all commodities on hand. Asking €114,450, about €1,133/m².

rows.title: Three-bedroom townhouse with two terraces in La Marina, Costa Blanca
rows.why_great: A townhouse of 116 m2 in the La Marina urbanisation on the southern Costa Blanca, extended upwards to give three bedrooms and two bathrooms, including an extra-large main bedroom. The second floor has a laundry room, two further bedrooms and a bathroom with WC, and a cellar offers space for storage. Gas central heating, double glazing and mains drainage are included. rows.title: Renovated one-bedroom country house on 4,000 m² of land near Francavilla Fontana, Puglia

rows.title: Victorian house with original oak woodwork opposite a park in Marietta, Ohio

It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms (one on the ground floor), an eat-in kitchen, a separate dining room, ground-floor laundry and a floored walk-up attic. Outside there is a front porch, rear deck, fenced back garden and a one-car detached garage. A city park, the library and the river trail are across the street or close by. rows.why_great: This move-in ready village house offers 136 m2 of living space across 4 rooms. It has 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a large living room spanning both sides of the building, and a separate equipped kitchen with storage and a dining area. Outdoor features include a garden, a garage with one parking space, and 4,123 sq ft of land. The home has oil-fired central heating, double glazing throughout, new PVC windows and electric shutters. Asking €129,000, about €949/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom terraced house with terrace and land in Lormes, Burgundy
rows.why_great: This fully renovated terraced house in the centre of Lormes is move-in ready with no work expected. It has 83 m2 of living space, five rooms and four bedrooms, plus one shower room. The property has a small composite terrace at the rear, a land plot of 1,152 sq ft, and a storage building with a basement and attic. Heating is electric and the orientation is east and west. Shops are close by. Asking €63,000, about €759/m².

rows.title: 5-bedroom village house with land and balcony in Espéraza, Aude, Languedoc
rows.why_great: This village house in Espéraza offers 130 m2 of living space over three floors. The ground floor has a 29.82 m2 living room and a 13.13 m2 fitted kitchen, and the upper floors hold five bedrooms and two shower rooms. A small balcony serves the first floor, and three non-adjoining plots of 1,490, 1,880 and 2,435 m2 are scattered across the commune, all uncultivated and unbuildable. The house has collective central heating and is five minutes from the town of Espéraza and its shops. Asking €114,500, about €881/m².

rows.title: 5-bedroom townhouse with garden, terrace and fireplace in Thouars, Deux-Sèvres
rows.why_great: This townhouse in Thouars offers about 143 square metres of living space across three levels. It has six rooms, five bedrooms, one bathroom, a fitted kitchen and a laundry room. Outside there is a terrace of about 50 m², a garden and a 184 m² plot, plus a vaulted cellar and a fireplace in the living room. Gas-fired central heating and hot water, double glazing, electric shutters and fibre optic. Energy rating C, near Parc Imbert and Ferdinand Buisson primary school. Asking €137,000, about €958/m².

rows.title: Restored 3-bedroom stone house with fireplace and garage in Lacapelle-Biron, Lot-et-Garonne
rows.why_great: This restored stone house on three levels was fully restored in 2003 and is in excellent condition. It has three bedrooms, a living room with an inset fireplace, a fitted kitchen, a first-floor living room with a fireplace opening onto a veranda, two shower rooms and a WC. A fully tiled garage, a tiled attic of 33 sq m and 1,044 sq ft of land complete the property. Electric heating is installed. Asking €121,700, about €901/m².

rows.title: 2-bedroom house with garden, fireplace and land in Perivolakia, Crete
rows.why_great: This house with a garden in Perivolakia sits about 12 km from the beach. It has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a living room with a fireplace and air conditioning, a kitchen, a laundry room and a guest WC. A covered veranda of about 15 m2 is at the entrance. The 288 m2 plot has a well maintained garden with automatic irrigation and fruit trees such as oranges, lemons, figs and olives. The home has a solar water heater and a peaceful setting within easy reach of the coast. Asking €105,000, about €1,400/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated house with terrace and second residence in Alcaudete de la Jara, Toledo
rows.why_great: This fully renovated house spreads over two floors and has access from two streets. The ground floor offers a living-dining room, a separate kitchen with pantry, an en-suite bedroom and a full bathroom, plus a second independent residence with two bedrooms and a full bathroom. Outdoor features include a patio, a large upper-level terrace, a storage room and a 171 m² plot. The home has air conditioning and a living area of 198 m². Asking €139,900, about €707/m².

rows.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with terrace and garage in Tonneins, Lot-et-Garonne
rows.why_great: This renovated three-bedroom house is ready to move into. The ground floor has a lounge, a large recently fitted kitchen, a shower room, a toilet, a laundry room and a garage over 30 m². The second floor has two spacious bedrooms, a room that could be a dressing room and an attic. Outdoors there is a terrace, 2,368 sq ft of land and a fireplace with a wood-burning insert. The home has mains gas heating, and the town centre, shops and railway station are close by. Asking €127,000, about €858/m².

rows.title: Detached 5-bedroom house with garden, barn and land in Ruffec, Charente
rows.why_great: This detached house has 8 rooms, including 5 bedrooms, a separate equipped kitchen and a shower room. Outside there are two private enclosed gardens, a barn of about 95 m², a workshop, a garage and other outbuildings, on 37,889 sq ft of land. There is parking for three cars, with one space in the garage, and oil-fired central heating. The house is 3 km from Ruffec, with schools, a train station and main roads to Poitiers and Angoulême. Asking €149,950, about €872/m².

rows.title: Stone house with terrace, garage and land in Porte-du-Quercy, Lot
rows.why_great: This traditional stone house in the village of Porte-du-Quercy, Lot, has an entrance hall, a dining room with kitchen and a utility kitchen with an old bread oven. Upstairs there are four large bedrooms and a bathroom. There is a 17 m² covered terrace, a large garage, outdoor parking and a 340 m² plot of land a few dozen metres from the house. Oil-fired central heating is fitted, and the energy rating is E. Asking €129,900, about €849/m².

rows.title: Three-level stone house with lake views and fireplace in Vicalvi, Frosinone, Lazio
rows.why_great: This three-level stone house stands in the historic centre of Vicalvi, a few steps from the castle. It has two bedrooms, one with an en suite bathroom, a living room that can serve as a third bedroom, and three bathrooms. Balconies offer views over the lake of the Posta Fibreno Nature Reserve. The lower floor has a taverna with stone arches, a fireplace, a cellar and a private courtyard. Heating is by independent natural gas. Asking €120,000, about €571/m².

rows.title: 2-bedroom house in good condition with garden and conservatory in Ploërdut, Morbihan, Brittany
rows.why_great: This 2-bedroom house in good condition offers 103 m² of living space in Ploërdut. Downstairs there are an entrance, kitchen, lounge, utility room, WC and conservatory, and upstairs two bedrooms and a shower room with WC. The enclosed garden has its own well, the plot totals 274 m² of land, and a large attic offers potential for more living space. The house has double glazing, oil central heating and a woodburner. It is 8 minutes' drive from Guémené-sur-Scorff, 20 minutes from Rostrenen and about 45 minutes from the South Coast. Asking €91,120, about €885/m².

rows.title: Town centre house with garden and garage in Le Croisty, Brittany
rows.why_great: This house is located in the town centre of Le Croisty, in the Morbihan department of Brittany. The home, a former shop, offers an entrance, a separate fitted and equipped kitchen, a dining room, two bedrooms and a large bedroom upstairs. It includes a garden, a garage and 215 sq ft of land. The basement was formerly a butcher's laboratory. Asking €123,000, about €911/m².

rows.title: 4-bedroom old house with fireplace and garage in Saint-Porchaire, Charente-Maritime
rows.why_great: This old house in Saint-Porchaire has four bedrooms, high ceilings and large rooms. The ground floor has a hallway, a living room with a south-facing fireplace and a large kitchen with a back kitchen and direct access to an about 15 m2 garage. Upstairs there are four bedrooms, a shower room and a laundry room, and the top floor has a convertible 74 m2 attic. Several parking spaces are nearby, and there is no garden. Oil-fired central heating is installed, and Saintes is 15 minutes away. Asking €117,167, about €862/m².

airport.name: La Rochelle Île de Ré Airport

rows.title: Townhouse with covered terrace and countryside views in El Colmenar, Málaga, Andalusia
rows.why_great: Two-storey townhouse in the white village of El Colmenar, with 158 m2 of living area. It has two bedrooms, two bathrooms, an open-plan kitchen and an open-plan living room with French terrace windows. Outdoors there is a covered terrace, a balcony, an internal patio and countryside views. The property sits on 807 sq ft of land. Double-glazed PVC windows and ceramic floor tiles run throughout. Asking €135,000, about €854/m².

rows.title: Stone country house with garden and outbuildings in Marmande, Lot-et-Garonne
rows.why_great: Stone country house a few minutes from Marmande, with stone walls under the render and a calm setting. The ground floor has an entrance, a separate kitchen and a bright lounge opening onto a gallery, while upstairs there are two bedrooms of over 20 m² each and an office. The enclosed plot of about 3,000 m² includes a garden with fruit trees, outbuildings, a well, a garage and parking spaces. Wood heating, 105 m² of living space and an extension of about 60 m² is possible upstairs. Asking €89,500, about €852/m².

rows.title: Period 3-bedroom village house with terraces and rooftop views in Caunes-Minervois, Languedoc
rows.why_great: This characterful house of about 101 m2 has period features such as terracotta tiles, solid wood flooring and stone walls. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a separate toilet, plus an attic room usable as an office, workshop or guest bedroom. Two terraces include a rooftop terrace with unobstructed views over the rooftops. Heating is electric and aerothermal, and shops and restaurants are within walking distance. Asking €85,000, about €842/m².

rows.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and land in Fénery, Deux-Sèvres
rows.why_great: This renovated semi-detached house offers 135 m² of living space across five rooms, including three bedrooms. The bright living room measures 30 m² and has double-glazed PVC windows. A separate kitchen is fitted, and the house has separate toilets, a shower room and a cellar. The fully enclosed plot of 5.05 acres includes a garden and an attic for storage. Heating comes from wood heating and an individual heating system, and shops, schools and medical facilities are within a 15-minute drive. Asking €116,850, about €866/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom townhouse with balconies and cellar in Alanno, Abruzzo
rows.why_great: This move-in ready townhouse is in good condition and can be lived in immediately. It offers 110 square metres with two bedrooms, a study, one bathroom, a kitchen, a dining area, a living room and a second small kitchen. Both bedrooms have private balconies, and a separate entrance leads to a spacious cellar. The home has gas-fired central heating, is located in a central village position and is less than 30 minutes by car from the Adriatic beaches. Asking €59,000, about €536/m².

rows.title: Historic-centre townhouse with two bathrooms and land in Estremoz, Alentejo
rows.why_great: This townhouse on two floors sits in the historic centre of Estremoz, two minutes on foot from the castle. The ground floor has a kitchen with a dining area, a bedroom and a bathroom. The first floor has a living room with excellent natural light, a second bedroom and a second bathroom. The property includes 581 sq ft of land. Shops, restaurants, schools and public transport are close by. Asking €115,000, about €1,055/m².

rows.title: House in good condition with fireplace and garden in Foniskaria, Achaea, Western Greece
rows.why_great: This house in good condition was built in 1960 and offers 82 square metres of living space. It has one bedroom, one bathroom, a living room with a fireplace and an open plan kitchen. The plot of 4,087.87 square metres includes 150 olive trees, 100 lemon trees, warehouses, chicken coops and a tank, plus a garden and two parking spaces. The home has oil-fired central heating and air conditioning. Asking €125,000, about €1,524/m².

rows.title: Stone cottage in good condition with garden and fireplace in Limenaria, Thasos
rows.why_great: This stone cottage is in good condition and suited to year round living. It has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and an attic loft converted into a third bedroom, plus a separate kitchen and a sunroom. Outdoor features include a garden, a terrace, a cellar, a fireplace with wood stoves and sheds for wood storage, on 3,531 sq ft of land. The village has a mini market, cafes and tavernas. Asking €140,000, about €1,400/m².

airport.name: Kavala Alexander the Great International Airport

rows.title: Renovated 3-bedroom stone house with cellar in Limoux, Aude
rows.why_great: This renovated stone house on two levels sits in a village about 10 minutes from Limoux. The ground floor has a 53 m2 living room, lounge and kitchen, plus a shower room with WC. The first floor has a large landing, two bedrooms (14 m2 and 12 m2, the latter with a 4 m2 mezzanine) and a shower room with WC. The second floor has a 17 m2 bedroom and a 7 m2 attic or storage room. A detached cellar with a 30 m2 room lies 50 m from the house. Features include wood heating and a south orientation, and Limoux with its shops is about 10 minutes away. Asking €108,000, about €923/m².

rows.title: Former rectory house with garden, garage and land in Précy-sous-Thil, Burgundy
rows.why_great: This former rectory house adjoins the village church and keeps its period character. Inside, it has several rooms, including a ground-floor bedroom, with exposed beams and generous volumes. Outside, there is a green, quiet garden, a garage and 9,246 sq ft of land. The house has gas-fired central heating. It stands in the Auxois area of Burgundy, in a rural village setting. Asking €129,000, about €843/m².

rows.title: Spacious 4-bedroom house with fireplace, garage and views in Simorre, Gers
rows.why_great: This large house suits a large family and could be divided into two separate apartments. It has four bedrooms, a lounge with kitchen corner, a living room with fireplace and kitchen area, a shower room and separate toilets. Extra features include a garage with toilet and views over the plain. Heating is by wood stove, with water connection, sewage, a telephone line and a gas bottle. It is in the centre of a small village in the department of Gers. Asking €123,000, about €794/m².

rows.title: 4-bedroom house with mountain views, garage and terrace in Espezel, Aude
rows.why_great: This 168 m² house sits on the Sault plateau in the village of Espezel. It has 4 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, spread over three floors, with a shower room and a fitted kitchen. Outdoor and extra features include a 25 m² south-facing terrace, a 25 m² garage, a balcony on the second floor and mountain views. The house has wood and electric heating and is connected to the mains sewer system. Ski resorts are a short distance away. Asking €138,000, about €821/m².

rows.title: Renovated period house with garden and double garage in Eauze, Gers
rows.why_great: This renovated period house stands in the heart of Eauze, Gers. It offers 210 m² of living space with a fitted kitchen with central island, a large 46 m² living room with a wood-burning insert, five bedrooms, a 7 m² office and two shower rooms. Outside there is a garden and a plot of 1,453 sq ft, plus a double garage with roller shutters and a workshop. Heating is provided by a pellet boiler, and the double glazing was installed in 2023. Asking €139,990, about €673/m².

rows.title: House with garage and open-plan kitchen in Caudiès-de-Fenouillèdes, Pyrénées-Orientales
rows.why_great: This 204 m2 house has 8 rooms and 3 bedrooms. Two shower rooms and separate toilets are included, along with an open-plan equipped kitchen. A garage with one parking space is included. Electric heating is installed, and the energy performance class is B while the climate class is A. Estimated annual energy costs for standard use were between 1570 and 2180 euros for 2021 to 2023, including subscriptions. Asking €149,900, about €735/m².

rows.title: Detached 5-bedroom house with fireplace and plot in Saint-Julien-Chapteuil, Haute-Loire
rows.why_great: This detached house of 220 m² spreads over three floors with five bedrooms. The ground floor has a large living area, a separate living and dining room, a kitchen, a shower room and a separate toilet. Upstairs are a living area, three bedrooms, a study and a bathroom, plus two attic bedrooms and a mezzanine. A fireplace with a wood-burning stove, individual heating and radiators, plus a plot amid green spaces. Schools, shops and transport are nearby, with Le Puy-en-Velay 17 minutes away and Estables ski resort 29 minutes. Asking €150,000, about €682/m².

rows.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and town views in Argenton-sur-Creuse, Indre
rows.why_great: This house in Argenton-sur-Creuse is made of two connected houses with several possible uses. Living space includes an entrance room, two kitchens, two lounges, three bedrooms and two shower rooms, plus a large attic. Outside, there is a private garden with fruit trees, a courtyard terrace and views over the town. Extras include a fireplace, a large garage with cellar, and 11,410 sq ft of land. Asking €99,510, about €765/m².

rows.title: Character 2-bedroom house with south-facing terrace and garden in Fréville, Vosges
rows.why_great: This character house in Fréville has authentic traditional style and a warm atmosphere. It includes a spacious kitchen opening onto a south-facing terrace, plus a dining room, living room and shower room. Upstairs, a mezzanine leads to two large bedrooms and a bathroom with shower and toilet. Outside you will find a garden, a garage, a garden shed and a plot of land. The house has wood heating and sits near Neufchâteau. Asking €119,000, about €768/m².

rows.title: Restored 3-bedroom farmhouse with garden and fireplace in Nanteuil-Auriac-de-Bourzac, Dordogne
rows.why_great: Restored farmhouse of 209 m2 in a quiet hamlet, split into a 155 m2 main house and an attached 54 m2 cottage. The main house has 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a living room with a fireplace, a dining room and a kitchen. Outdoors there is a garden, a terrace, a plot of 541 m2 plus a separate 292 m2 plot, and an adjoining workshop. Heating is a wood stove, and the home is about twenty kilometers from Riberac. Asking €152,600, about €730/m².

rows.title: Character 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and cellar in Autun, Burgundy
rows.why_great: Character house with origins in the 17th century, partly built on a vaulted cellar in a peripheral district of Autun. It has a 29 m² living room with fireplace, a 13.50 m² kitchen, a 15.50 m² dining room and two ground floor bedrooms, plus a bathroom and WC. The upper floor has two bedrooms of 22 and 30 m². The fully enclosed 1,470 m² plot has a garden, orchard, vegetable garden, well, covered terrace, garage and hen house. Central heating runs on fuel with cast iron radiators. Asking €127,000, about €765/m².

rows.title: 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
rows.why_great: This 201 m2 house has four bedrooms and a 73 m2 living room overlooked by a mezzanine. It also has a separate equipped kitchen, a shower room and a ground floor room that could be an office. Outdoor features include a garden, a covered terrace and a private courtyard. A garage, two parking spaces and 54,358 sq ft of land complete the plot. Electric heating is fitted, and the village of Nanteuil-en-Vallée is a 10-minute drive away. Asking €147,970, about €736/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom townhouse with river views and fireplace in Chabanais, Charente
rows.why_great: Move-in ready townhouse with original wooden flooring and staircase, arranged over three floors. It has two bedrooms, plus an attic room used as a third bedroom, with a shower room and WC on the ground floor and a bathroom and WC on the first floor. Other features include a fireplace, 732 sq ft of land and superb views over the river, which is within walking distance. Town gas central heating is fitted, and shops and restaurants are within easy walking distance. Asking €64,500, about €665/m².

rows.title: Cottage with barn, fireplace and garden in Bussière-Poitevine, Haute-Vienne
rows.why_great: This cottage sits in a quiet hamlet and is ideal to lock up and leave. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a cosy living room with a fireplace, and a kitchen diner. Outside there is a wooden deck, a large attached barn, a 710 m² garden opposite the house and 2.85 acres of land. Heating is by wood, and the village with shops and a medical centre is a few minutes away. Limoges and Poitiers airports are about 50 minutes away. Asking €60,000, about €667/m².

rows.title: Stone farmhouse with garden, terrace and Pyrenees views in Marciac, Gers
rows.why_great: This stone farmhouse offers 220 m² of living space across four rooms, including two bedrooms and one bathroom. The ground floor has a 27 m² kitchen with a fireplace and wood-burning stove, and a 44 m² living room with direct access to a south-facing terrace. The property includes a garden of about 2,600 m² with views of the Pyrenees, plus a 70 m² hangar and a chalet. Heating comes from two wood-burning stoves, and hot water from a gas-fired water heater. Marciac is 7 minutes away, and Tarbes airport and TGV station are 35 minutes away. Asking €144,000, about €655/m².

rows.title: Renovated 3-bedroom village house near river in Rupt-aux-Nonains, Meuse, Lorraine
rows.why_great: This renovated village house offers a ground-floor kitchen, a living and dining room, and a utility and boiler room. Upstairs there are 3 bedrooms, a games room, a bathroom and a separate toilet. A river runs through the village, and the home is connected to the mains sewer system. Collective central heating is included, and the property has no garage or land. It sits in the Saulx Valley between Saint-Dizier and Ligny-en-Barrois, close to the RN4. Asking €88,000, about €854/m².

rows.title: 2-bedroom cottage with barn and land in Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente
rows.why_great: This two-bedroom cottage sits in a well maintained hamlet in Exideuil-sur-Vienne. Downstairs is an open plan kitchen, lounge and dining area, and upstairs has two bedrooms that take double beds and the bathroom. A good sized barn stands to the side, and a sizeable plot of 1460 m2 lies a short walk away. Canoeing and other water sports on the Vienne river are nearby. The home has 84 m2 of living space and electric heating. Asking €56,000, about €667/m².

rows.title: 3-bedroom townhouse with terrace, garage and cellar in Nueil-les-Aubiers, Deux-Sèvres
rows.why_great: Two-storey townhouse of 145 m2, built in 1947 in stone and brick, on a 197 m2 plot. It has 6 rooms, including 3 bedrooms, a bright 27.54 m2 living room, a fitted open-plan kitchen, a bathroom and a toilet. Features include a terrace, garage, external parking, cellar and land. Heating comes from a wood stove and a heat pump with radiators, and hot water from a thermodynamic system. Schools and shops such as bakeries and a supermarket are nearby. Asking €123,050, about €849/m².

rows.title: House with 7 bedrooms, garden and land in Dracy-Saint-Loup, Burgundy
rows.why_great: House of 265 m² with 7 bedrooms and one bathroom, set on a plot of 860 m² in Dracy-Saint-Loup. The main house has 7 rooms and 4 bedrooms, with a 46 m² living room, and a secondary house has 3 rooms, 2 bedrooms and a 25 m² living room. Outdoor space includes a 500 m² garden at the back, a 100 m² courtyard at the front and a parking space. Heating is gas-fired central heating in the main house and electric heating in the secondary house. Asking €142,000, about €536/m².

rows.title: Stone 4-bedroom house with fireplace and shops within walking distance in Eymet, Dordogne
rows.why_great: This stone house in Eymet has four bedrooms and 165 m2 of living space over six rooms. The 45 m2 living room has a fireplace, and there is a separate fitted kitchen, two bedrooms on the ground floor and two upstairs. Each floor has a shower room and toilet, and the home has double glazing, wooden shutters and a south orientation. A parking space is included, and schools, shops and doctors are within walking distance. The house is about 30 minutes from Bergerac. Asking €127,500, about €773/m².

rows.title: Townhouse with commercial space, three suites and terrace in Ruffec, Charente
rows.why_great: Townhouse on Ruffec's main square with a ground-floor commercial space of about 24 sqm, a shop window, WC and kitchen. Upstairs are three independent suites, including a 41 sqm suite with shower room, WC and private terrace. Features include a cellar, 549 sq ft of land and views of the town. Double glazing, electric heating and mains drainage with shops and the covered market steps away and Poitiers and Limoges airports under 45 minutes. Asking €99,900, about €787/m².

rows.title: 4-bedroom village house with fireplace and land in Cressy-sur-Somme, Saône-et-Loire, Burgundy
rows.why_great: This village house in Cressy-sur-Somme offers 150 m² of living space. Downstairs there is a living room with a fireplace, a kitchen, a bathroom, a toilet and a utility and boiler room, while upstairs has four bedrooms and a dressing room. There is an attic, a cellar, a small outbuilding and a woodshed, plus a plot of 883 m². Heating comes from a wood-burning insert and a wood-fired boiler, and the property is connected to mains drainage. Asking €123,000, about €820/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom house with land and wood stove in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
rows.why_great: A fully renovated house in a small peaceful village, suited to a family or as a second home. It has three bedrooms, one on the ground floor and two upstairs, with the possibility of converting a fourth. The property has 105 m2 of living space and 5,156 sq ft of land, along with a separate equipped kitchen and a shower room. Heating comes from a wood stove and electric heating. Ruffec is 12 minutes away, with shops and services nearby. Asking €71,000, about €676/m².

rows.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and cellar in Martinvelle, Vosges, Lorraine
rows.why_great: Independent house of 193 square metres on a fenced, planted plot of 497 square metres. Ground floor has a bright living room with Vosges limestone slabs, a fireplace with wood-burning stove, a fitted kitchen and a study, plus 3 bedrooms upstairs. Extra features include a garden, a terrace, a garage, a vaulted cellar and an attic. Heating is oil-fired central heating, and the village is close to all amenities. Asking €129,000, about €668/m².

rows.title: Spacious 6-bedroom house with garage and fireplace in Zurgena, Almería
rows.why_great: Spacious village house in Zurgena with 335 m2 of living space spread over several floors. It has six bedrooms and two bathrooms, including two en-suite bathrooms, one with a shower and one with a bathtub. Highlights include high ceilings, a central staircase, Andalusian-style flooring and a fireplace in a storage room. A garage is reached directly from the kitchen, and the village offers all essential services within easy reach. Asking €139,000, about €415/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready house with two apartments and courtyard in Saint-Martory, Haute-Garonne
rows.why_great: This move-in ready house in Saint-Martory comprises two apartments of 85 m2 and 95 m2 linked by an inner courtyard. It offers 7 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 1 shower room and an equipped kitchen across 200 m2 of living space. The windows are double-glazed PVC, the roof is in good condition, and the building has two separate water meters and mains drainage. Both apartments are vacant at purchase and the energy rating is E. Asking €139,000, about €695/m².

rows.title: Good condition 6-bedroom farmhouse with garden, terrace and fireplace in Piteglio, Tuscany
rows.why_great: This farmhouse is in good condition and offers a solid base for furnishing and using it to your own taste. It extends over three floors with six bedrooms, two bathrooms, a separate kitchen and a living area of 260 m2. Outdoor and extra features include a garden, a terrace, a fireplace, a cellar and about 3,500 sqm of adjoining land. The property sits a few kilometres from Garfagnana and Abetone, on the border with the province of Lucca. Asking €105,000, about €404/m².

rows.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Morla de la Valdería, León
rows.why_great: This renovated single-storey house in the village of Morla de la Valdería offers modern comforts with traditional character. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom with shower tray, and a bright living room-kitchen with a fitted kitchen. The living room opens to the rear garden, and there is also a terrace. The property includes a garage and 1,733 sq ft of land. Asking €80,000, about €721/m².
rows.location_name: Morla de la Valdería, León, Castilla y León

rows.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Onlay, Nièvre
rows.why_great: This house in Onlay offers 102 m2 of living space across three bedrooms and two shower rooms. The 25 m2 living room has a wood stove, French beams and French doors onto the sunny terrace. The home has a 530 m2 garden, a garage, a cellar and oil-fired central heating. The spa village with all amenities is 10 km away. Asking €60,000, about €588/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom former school house with garden and views in Genouillé, Vienne
rows.why_great: This fully renovated former school in Genouillé has been converted into two connected homes. It has 6 rooms, 4 bedrooms, a shower room and 205 m2 of living space, including a bright studio. Outside there is a garden on 18,514 sq ft of land, plus an insulated garage and a parking space. The setting offers uninterrupted views of the surrounding area. Three heat pumps, double glazing and electric shutters are installed. Asking €148,950, about €727/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom stone house with terrace and castle views in Sax, Alicante
rows.why_great: This fully renovated house was built in 1885 and is ready to move in. It has four bedrooms, two bathrooms, a separate furnished kitchen and several living rooms, including a living-dining room of 22.8 m2. Outdoor features include a terrace, an interior patio of more than 41 m2, views of the castle, a fireplace and 1,281 sq ft of land, plus an outbuilding next to the patio. The home has heating and split inverter air conditioning, and its stone walls are about 50 cm thick. Asking €112,000, about €709/m².

rows.title: Character 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Gannay-sur-Loire, Allier
rows.why_great: This character house in Gannay-sur-Loire offers 175 m2 of living space and three bedrooms. The first floor has an entrance hall, two living rooms, a kitchen/dining room, two bedrooms and a bathroom, and two more bedrooms are upstairs. The 2430 m2 plot includes a garden, plus a vast garage with workshop, a boiler room and a cellar. It is a stone's throw from the Canal du Nivernais, with Decize about 15 minutes away and Moulins less than 30 minutes. Asking €129,000, about €737/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom stone house with garden and hangar in Chalvraines, Haute-Marne
rows.why_great: Move-in ready stone house in a quiet village, with four bedrooms. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a living room, a lounge, a kitchen with direct garden access, and a bedroom with en-suite bathroom and WC. Upstairs there are three bedrooms, a dressing room, a shower room, a separate WC and two attics. The 1,633 m2 plot includes a garden, a basement cellar and a hangar of about 167 m2 at the end of the garden. Heating is oil-fired central heating with a pellet stove, and the windows are double-glazed. Asking €129,800, about €750/m².

rows.title: Renovated 2-bedroom character house with cellar in Couiza, Aude
rows.why_great: This renovated character house in Couiza offers 133 m2 of living space over three levels and is ready to live in. It includes a 20 m2 dining room, an open equipped kitchen of 18 m2, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a shower room. A 35 m2 cellar with outside access, double glazed wooden windows and parquet floors complete the home. The house has electric heating and east and west orientation. Asking €99,950, about €752/m².

rows.title: Farmhouse with mezzanine, garden and large plot in Saint-Denis-sur-Ouanne, Burgundy
rows.why_great: This farmhouse-style house offers 172 m2 of living space with two bedrooms in Saint-Denis-sur-Ouanne, Burgundy. The ground floor has a living room with a wood-burning stove, a dining area, a fitted kitchen, a hallway, a bedroom, a shower room, a WC and a boiler room. A spacious mezzanine overlooks the living area and can be adapted as a study, games room or extra sleeping area, and a hatch gives access to an attic. The plot of about 1,800 m2 includes a garden, a storage shed and an outbuilding, in a peaceful setting. Heating is by wood, and the house suits use as a holiday home or a year-round residence. Asking €128,000, about €744/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready stone townhouse with fireplace and terrace in Montsecret-Clairefougère, Normandy
rows.why_great: This move-in ready stone townhouse is ready to move in now, in a small village with a shop. It has 4 rooms, including 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a separate toilet and a 28 m2 living room/kitchen with a fireplace. Outdoor features include a terrace, a covered patio and 1,238 sq ft of land. Electric radiators provide heating, and the home has fibre and collective sewer sanitation. Tinchebray is 6 km away and Flers is 11 km away. Asking €69,000, about €663/m².

rows.title: House with garden, orchard and terrace in Martinvelle, Vosges
rows.why_great: This village house offers 136 m² across six rooms, with four bedrooms and one bathroom. The ground floor has a fitted kitchen, a living room with terrace access and a pellet stove, plus a WC and storeroom. Upstairs, three bedrooms include one with a dressing room. Features include a garden, an orchard, a terrace, a covered terrace, a cellar, an attic or mezzanine and a garage, on a flat 3,650 m² plot. Heating is electric plus a pellet stove. Asking €110,000, about €809/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready stone house with garden and fireplace in Armeni, Crete
rows.why_great: This move-in ready stone house is furnished and decorated to a high standard, with a modern feel and traditional touches. It has two double bedrooms, one bathroom, an open plan living and dining area with a wood burner, and a fully fitted kitchen with a large open fireplace. Outdoor features include a shaded front terrace, a well established garden, a 606 sqm plot with fruit trees, and parking at the entrance. The home has electric water heating. Armeni lies roughly 27 km southwest of Sitia town. Asking €145,000, about €1,381/m².

rows.title: 4-bedroom manor house with garden, terrace and outbuilding in Durance, Lot-et-Garonne
rows.why_great: This manor house in Durance offers 307 m2 of living space and four bedrooms. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a study, a large lounge, a living room, a kitchen, a rear kitchen and a toilet. Upstairs, four bedrooms, two bathrooms and an additional room share the first floor with a separate toilet. Outside, a 4,900 m2 tree-filled park has a garden, a terrace and a separate outbuilding, on a plot of 52,743 sq ft. The home has oil-fired central heating and one parking space. Asking €149,800, about €488/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom house with balcony and land in Villanueva de las Torres, Granada
rows.why_great: This fully renovated house combines traditional local architecture with modern finishes. It has four bedrooms, one bathroom, bright living areas and a fully equipped independent kitchen. Outdoor and extra features include a private balcony, 958 sq ft of land, air conditioning, individual climate control and fiber-optic internet. The home is in a quiet village with restaurants, a school, a pharmacy and supermarkets, minutes from Guadix and less than an hour from Granada. Asking €115,000, about €646/m².

rows.title: 2-bedroom country house with fireplace, land and outbuildings in Mautes, Creuse
rows.why_great: This country house has two bedrooms and 137 m² of living space. The ground floor holds a kitchen with dining room of 35 m², a 31 m² living room, a boiler room and a WC, while upstairs there is a hallway, a mezzanine and a shower room. The land includes 576 m² attached and 183 m² detached, plus an outbuilding on two levels, an old bread oven opposite the house and a fireplace. It has oil-fired central heating. Asking €110,000, about €803/m².

rows.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with garden and views in Vrises, Crete
rows.why_great: This renovated house sits on two levels in the mountain village of Vrises. The upper level has an open plan living room, dining area and fitted kitchen with balcony access, two double bedrooms and a bathroom. The lower level has two storage rooms. The property has a private garden with mature trees, views, central heating and solar water heating. The plot is approx 350m2, Neapolis is a 5 minute drive away and Heraklion airport is within a one hour drive. Asking €115,000, about €1,278/m².

rows.title: In good condition 2-bedroom house with open-plan living room in Eretria, Euboea
rows.why_great: This house, built in 1998, is in good condition and sits on the ground floor. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and an open-plan kitchen and living room in 88 m2 of living space. The structure and exterior are in good structural condition. Heating is oil-fired central heating, and the energy rating is B. It is located in Eretria, Euboea, Central Greece. Asking €108,000, about €1,227/m².

rows.title: Country house in good condition with olive garden and fireplace in Dimitropoulo, Achaea
rows.why_great: This two-level country house, built in 1980, is in good condition and sits on a 1,200 sq m plot of land. The ground floor has a large living room with a fireplace, a kitchen and a bathroom, and the first floor has a bedroom with WC. Outside there is a garden with 16 olive trees and a terrace. The living room has an air conditioner, and the home is in Dimitropoulo, Aigialia, Achaea. Asking €120,000, about €1,237/m².

rows.title: Renovated 3-bedroom detached house with fireplace and land in Kainourgio, Phthiotis
rows.why_great: This renovated detached house is move-in ready, with the structure in good condition. It has three bedrooms, an open-plan living room and kitchen, and one bathroom. Features include a fireplace, a plot of about 300 sq.m., an open parking space and an independent 20 sq.m. storage room. The home has individual oil heating and four air-conditioning units. The beach is about 2.3 km away, the E75 motorway about 3 km and Nea Anchialos Airport about 114 km. Asking €130,000, about €1,161/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom house with garden and garage in Manot, Charente
rows.why_great: This move-in ready house is furnished and ready to move in or rent. It has a living room, a fitted and equipped kitchen, four bedrooms, a shower room with WC and a bathroom with WC. Outside, you get a separate garden of 219 m2, an adjoining garage of 17 m2 and 3,595 sq ft of land. It has oil central heating and mains drainage, and it is 9 km from Confolens in the centre of the village with local shops. Asking €60,500, about €582/m².

rows.title: 4-bedroom house with terrace and fireplace in Ourjout, Ariège
rows.why_great: This three-level house in the village of Ourjout has four or five bedrooms and 145 sq m of living space. It includes a 34 sq m living room, a 23 sq m kitchen, two bathrooms and three toilets. Outdoor features include a 25 sq m covered area, a terrace, a fireplace and one parking space. It has double glazing and electric heating from convectors. Castillon en Couserans, the canton's main town, is 3 km away. Asking €108,000, about €745/m².

rows.title: House with garden, barn and fireplace in Jaulnay, Indre-et-Loire
rows.why_great: This village house of about 125 m2 is arranged over two levels. It has three bedrooms, a study area, a fitted kitchen, and one bathroom with a shower and bathtub. Two living areas totalling about 43 m2 include a central fireplace. Outside, there is a garden of about 900 m2, a 45 m2 barn, and a courtyard where a vehicle can be parked. Electric heating is installed, shops are within walking distance, and the A10 motorway and a TGV station are within 20 minutes. Asking €93,090, about €745/m².

rows.title: In good condition 3-bedroom house with terrace and land in San Venanzo, Umbria
rows.why_great: This detached house in San Venanzo is in good condition. It is arranged over two floors and has three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a spacious living room, a kitchenette and a study. It has a terrace, a balcony, a traditional fireplace, a detached garage, a small outbuilding and about 3,500 sqm of private land, partly woodland. The home has independent LPG heating, and Orvieto is 20 km away. Asking €85,000, about €512/m².

airport.name: Perugia San Francesco d'Assisi – Umbria International Airport

rows.title: Fully renovated stone house with terrace and outbuilding in Tabuaço, Douro
rows.why_great: This fully renovated stone house is ready to move into, with a stone façade that gives good insulation. It has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 173 m2 of living area, plus a terrace, a fireplace and a parking space. A private plot of 428 m2 includes a detached outbuilding of 107.5 m2 that could become a second home, a local accommodation project or a garage. The house sits in a peaceful parish with vineyard views, just minutes from the Douro. Asking €140,000, about €809/m².

rows.title: Village house with wooden beams and covered terrace in Jijona, Alicante
rows.why_great: This is a village house with history, originally built in 1850 and spread across three floors. It has five bedrooms, a kitchen and exposed wooden beams, with a ground floor space of about 27 m². The home has a covered terrace and land of 1,173 sq ft. It is located in the urban center of Jijona, Alicante. The energy certificate rates consumption E and emissions D. Asking €125,000, about €514/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom house with fireplace and land in Aldeias, Guarda
rows.why_great: This move-in ready house in Aldeias is ready to live in now. Downstairs is a kitchen with a fireplace and a service bathroom, and there are two bedrooms and a main living room. The main bathroom has a shower base, and a hallway has built-in wardrobe storage. The plot covers 441 sq ft of land, and a water heater provides hot water. It sits within the Serra da Estrela Natural Park, with public transport at the door to Gouveia and Seia. Asking €92,500, about €841/m².

rows.title: Townhouse with former bar, patio and roof solarium in Tolox, Málaga, Andalusia
rows.why_great: This townhouse in Tolox is a large home of 119 m2 spread over several floors. It has 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, plus a lounge, a kitchen, a laundry room and a ground floor area that was formerly a bar, with a small kitchen and toilets. Outdoor features include a patio and a large roof solarium with village views. The property has a separate entrance and sits in the centre of the spa town. Asking €76,000, about €639/m².

rows.title: 3-bedroom house with cellars, garage and terrace in Lormes, Burgundy
rows.why_great: This house is raised partly on two cellars. The ground floor has an entrance, a kitchen, a living room, a dining room, a WC and a garage. The first floor has a large landing serving three bedrooms, a WC, a shower room and a bathroom. Outside, there is a small terrace in front of the house, and one parking space is listed. It has electric heating and is oriented north and south, with risk information available on the Géorisques site. Asking €59,400, about €571/m².

rows.title: Two-dwelling stone house with barn and garden in Villars, Dordogne
rows.why_great: This stone house in Villars is made up of two separate dwellings in a quiet small hamlet. The first dwelling has three bedrooms, a living room with an adjoining barn, a kitchen, a shower room and a toilet, while the second has one bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and a shower room. Features include a garden, enclosed courtyard, fireplace, cellar, attic, outbuildings, barn, a 1983 m2 plot, a garage and a parking space. It has oil-fired central heating and is close to Brantôme. Asking €119,800, about €749/m².

rows.title: Three-storey 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and sauna in Fenioux, Deux-Sèvres
rows.why_great: This three-storey house is a maison bourgeoise with four bedrooms and 202 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a living room with a fireplace and a kitchen/diner with a log burner opening onto the terrace. Upstairs there are four bedrooms, two shower rooms, a bathroom and a sauna. Outside there is a terrace with a pergola, a garden, about 600 m2 of land, a cellar and a garage. Heating is by wood-burning stove and electric convectors, with Coulonges-sur-l'Autize 10 minutes away and Niort 30 minutes. Asking €124,800, about €618/m².

rows.title: Semi-detached 6-bedroom house with garden and land in Cirey-sur-Vezouze, Lorraine
rows.why_great: Semi-detached house in Cirey-sur-Vezouze with a garden, set on a plot of 273 m². It offers a living area of 147.7 m² across 8 rooms, including 6 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The ground floor has a living room, dining room, kitchen, two bedrooms and a WC, while the first floor has four more bedrooms and a bathroom with WC. Heating is oil-fired central heating. Energy class E. Asking €105,000, about €709/m².

rows.title: House in good condition with garden and garage in Cérilly, Allier
rows.why_great: This characterful house is in good condition with five bedrooms, two bathrooms and a separate kitchen. The ground floor has a living room, kitchen and bedroom, and the first floor has three bedrooms and a dressing room. Features include a south-facing garden of 120 m², a garage, a vaulted cellar, a fireplace and 1,292 sq ft of land. Electric heating and a large attic complete the house. It is 3 km from the Tronçais forest, near village shops, and 22 minutes by car from the train station. Asking €119,000, about €580/m².

rows.title: Renovated 4-bedroom house with garden and views in Lichères-sur-Yonne, Burgundy
rows.why_great: This renovated longère from the 1980s has a ground-floor entry, a kitchen and a dining room with a fireplace. Upstairs are 4 bedrooms, a dressing room and 1 bathroom, and the living room also has a fireplace. A large south-facing terrace raised above ground level offers unobstructed countryside views. A pleasant garden leads to an outbuilding with 2 closed garages, a workshop and a covered shelter. The 161 m2 home also has a small cellar and sits on 13,853 sq ft of land. Asking €120,000, about €745/m².

rows.title: 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Antugnac, Aude, Languedoc
rows.why_great: This house in the village of Antugnac offers approximately 160 m2 of living space on three levels. It has three bedrooms, a 26 m2 ground floor room, a 23 m2 living room, a 17.75 m2 dining room and a 10.73 m2 open-plan kitchen. Outdoor features include a rear garden, a front courtyard, a large garage, one parking space, 5,167 sq ft of land and two stone outbuildings. The village is about 40 minutes from Carcassonne and its airport, and less than an hour from the Pyrenees. Asking €115,000, about €719/m².

rows.title: House with fireplaces, large barn and land in Availles-Limouzine, Vienne
rows.why_great: This is a six-bedroom house in Availles-Limouzine, a village on the banks of the Vienne River. The ground floor has an eat-in kitchen and a large living room, both with fireplaces, plus a bathroom, a separate WC and a bedroom with its own fireplace. Upstairs are five bedrooms. The plot covers 2,744 m² with a large barn or garage that could take a second floor. The home has wood heating, and Confolens is about 17 minutes by car. Asking €79,900, about €655/m².

rows.title: Family house with private garden and large outbuilding in Saint-Léomer, Poitou-Charentes
rows.why_great: This family house in Saint-Léomer has a sunny aspect and large windows. Rooms include a dining room, a large living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms, a family bathroom, a downstairs WC and an attic. The plot covers 15,403 sq ft of land, with a private garden at the rear and a cellar. Across the road is a very large outbuilding with room to park cars, create a workshop and storage. It has oil-fired central heating and double glazing, Montmorillon is 10 minutes away and Poitiers airport is easily reached. Asking €104,500, about €731/m².

rows.title: Traditional stone 3-bedroom villa with studio and views in Exo Apidi, Crete
rows.why_great: This is a traditional stone villa in Exo Apidi, Crete. The main villa has an open plan living area with kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a studio with its own separate entrance and a bathroom. The home includes courtyards at the front and rear, views of the village and mountains, and a plot of 308 m2. It has air conditioning and all services connected, with the sea 8 km away. Asking €150,000, about €1,154/m².

rows.title: 2-bedroom house with sea views and terrace in Agios Stefanos, Crete
rows.why_great: This house spreads over three levels and offers 130 m2 of living area in Agios Stefanos, Crete. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a separate toilet, a kitchen, a dining room, a small living room with a fireplace and a store room. The second-floor living room can be turned into a bedroom with an en suite bathroom. Outdoors, there is a big balcony and a big terrace, both with sea views, and a plot of 145 m2 that can become a garden with a BBQ area. Asking €92,000, about €708/m².

rows.title: Spacious 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Collorec, Finistère, Brittany
rows.why_great: This spacious two-floor house has three bedrooms and 170 m2 of living area. The ground floor includes a large lounge and dining room, a kitchen, a utility room and a toilet, while upstairs there is an office, three bedrooms and a shower room with toilet. Outside, you will find a garden, a garage and an outbuilding used as a boiler room, set on 6,103 sq ft of land. A large attic provides storage or potential for conversion, subject to feasibility, with electric heating and air conditioning. Asking €103,000, about €606/m².

rows.title: 4-bedroom brick house with garage, cellars and outbuildings in Orbec, Calvados
rows.why_great: This brick house offers 142 m2 of living space across 6 rooms, with 4 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. It has an entrance hall, a kitchen, two living rooms of 20 m2 each and a toilet with a sink, plus upstairs a dressing room and a separate toilet. Extras include a 50 m2 garage, a second outbuilding, two cellars, an attic and a 3,100 sq ft plot. The house is 10 km from Orbec and 13 km from Vimoutiers. Asking €87,500, about €616/m².

rows.title: Detached 3-bedroom house in good condition with annex and garden in Kato Chorio, Crete
rows.why_great: This detached house is in good condition, with a main house and a self-contained annex on one level. It has 2 double bedrooms in the main house, a double bedroom in the annex, a kitchen/breakfast room, and a fireplace in the annex living room. The approximately 850 m2 garden plot has mature trees, a vegetable plot, 2 storage rooms and possible off-road parking. Water and electricity are connected, drainage is to a septic tank, and the sea is within a 15 minute drive. Asking €145,000, about €967/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready furnished house with terrace and fireplace in Komnina, Phthiotis, Central Greece
rows.why_great: Move-in ready detached house, built in 1987 and sold fully furnished with all electrical appliances. It has one bathroom, an open-plan living room and kitchen, built-in wardrobes and tiled floors. Outdoor and extra features include a terrace, a parking space, an 800 sq.m. plot, a 15 sq.m. external storage room and a fireplace. Oil heating and air conditioning are fitted. Kamena Vourla beach is about 10 km away, Thermopylae hot springs about 20 km, and Athens International Airport about 205 km. Asking €120,000, about €1,132/m².

rows.title: Traditional 3-bedroom two-storey house with sea views in Tourloti, Crete
rows.why_great: This traditional two-storey house stands about 3 km from the sea in Tourloti, East Crete. The ground floor, about 56 m2, has a kitchen-living area, a bedroom and an outdoor bathroom. The first floor, about 33 m2, has two large bedrooms and a balcony with sea views. The property also has village and mountain views and 700 sq ft of land. All services are connected and access is good. Asking €87,000, about €978/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom stone house with balcony and views in Aubin, Aveyron
rows.why_great: This move-in ready house in Aubin is a stone village home with habitable living spaces. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and 132 m2 of living area. A balcony offers panoramic village and mountain views, and the property includes 840 sq ft of land. Double glazing is fitted, and village shops and cafés are within walking distance. Rodez is about 38 km away and Toulouse-Blagnac Airport about 150 km. Asking €59,400, about €450/m².

rows.title: House in good condition with terrace, garden and parquet floors in Sperchogeia, Messenia
rows.why_great: This ground-floor house is in good condition, with a sound structure and exterior. It has 200 square metres of living space, 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a sitting room and a living room with wood parquet floors. Outdoor features include a terrace, a garden, a plot of 500 square metres, a west orientation and a view of the square. The sea is 4000 metres away and the airport is 5000 metres away. Wooden window frames complete the property. Asking €85,000, about €425/m².

rows.title: Restored 4-bedroom timber-framed house with garden and terrace in Le Neufour, Meuse, Lorraine
rows.why_great: Restored house built in 1850, with a facade restored in 2013 and a structure in good condition. It has four bedrooms, a living-kitchen, a living room and a shower room upstairs. A large rear garden has fruit trees and a pond, plus a covered terrace. The home also has a fireplace, a cellar, wood stoves and 10,979 sq ft of land. Heating is electric upstairs and wood stoves downstairs, and Clermont-en-Argonne is about 7 minutes away. Asking €95,000, about €633/m².

rows.title: Traditional stone house with sea views and fireplace in Achladia, Crete
rows.why_great: This is a traditional stone house in Achladia, with a living area of about 95 m2. It has three bedrooms, one of which has a separate entrance, and one bathroom. The living area has a fireplace, and a courtyard leads to a roof terrace with views of the sea and mountains. The house stands on a plot of 114 m2. Solar panels and central heating are fitted, the sea is 8 km away, and all services are connected. Asking €86,000, about €905/m².

rows.title: Two-level 4-bedroom house with garden and garage in Buxières-sous-les-Côtes, Meuse, Lorraine
rows.why_great: This semi-detached house spreads 170 m² of living space over two levels. Four bedrooms, one bathroom, a shower room and a separate kitchen. Outdoor and extra features include a 240 m² garden, a terrace, a 41 m² garage, a cellar, a fireplace and 3,638 sq ft of land. Heating is by fuel boiler and open fireplace, with a micro-station for sanitation. Lake La Madine is 10 minutes away and Meuse TGV Station 15 minutes. Asking €125,000, about €735/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom detached house with garden and fireplace in Mikropoli, Drama
rows.why_great: This fully renovated detached house dates from before 1955 and is arranged over two levels connected by an internal staircase. It has three bedrooms with wardrobes, two living rooms, a fitted kitchen with electrical appliances, and one bathroom. Outdoor and extra features include a large garden, a fireplace, a storage room, and an 830 sq.m. plot. The property has independent oil-fired heating. It is available immediately. Asking €80,000, about €541/m².

airport.name: Kavala Alexander the Great International Airport

rows.title: In good condition 3-bedroom maisonette with mountain views and fireplace in Archanes, Crete
rows.why_great: This ground-floor maisonette is in good condition. It has 3 bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and 1 bathroom, with mosaic and wood floors. A fireplace, cupboards and a 65 sq m storage unit are included, and the land measures 2,056 sq ft. The home has mountain views, and the building dates from 1960. The sea is 10 km away, the city centre is 10 km away, the nearest village is 10 m away, and the airport is 10 km away. Asking €130,000, about €684/m².

rows.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom house with cellar and outbuildings in Monts-sur-Guesnes, Vienne
rows.why_great: Move-in ready house in Monts-sur-Guesnes, with 238 m² of living space and 4 bedrooms. It includes a 38 m² living room, a 34 m² fitted kitchen with a wood stove, a bathroom and a separate toilet. Extras include a cellar, a courtyard, outbuildings, a separate plot for 2 vehicles and a large insulated attic. Double glazing, mains drainage and 2 chimney flues ready for a pellet or wood stove are included. Schools, shops and a doctor are in the village, 17 km from Loudun and 46 km from Poitiers. Asking €95,700, about €402/m².

rows.title: 2-bedroom house with garden and courtyard in Stavrochori, Crete
rows.why_great: This house in Stavrochori, South East Crete, has an open plan living area with kitchen. It has two bedrooms and one bathroom, with about 100 m2 of living space. The plot covers approximately 200 m2 and includes a garden and courtyard of about 100 m2. The house is 7 km from the sea and 7 km from Makry Gialos and all amenities. Asking €85,000, about €850/m².

rows.title: Renovated 2-bedroom two-level house with garden and separate entrances in Akoumia, Crete
rows.why_great: This renovated two-level house in the village of Akoumia has two separate entrances, giving each floor its own access. The ground floor has one bedroom, a bathroom and a kitchen, while the first floor has two bedrooms, a kitchen and a bathroom. A private garden and a balcony add outdoor space for dining and relaxing. The village is 39 km from Rethymno. It is located near the village central square. Asking €105,000, about €897/m².

rows.title: Renovated 4-bedroom house with courtyard and barn in Les Salles-Lavauguyon, Haute-Vienne
rows.why_great: Renovated four-bedroom house of 180 m2 in the centre of a village. The ground floor has a tiled hall, kitchen, living room, dining room, WC and a bedroom or office. Upstairs, three bedrooms include two with en suite shower rooms and a large separate bathroom. The 2,583 sq ft plot includes a courtyard with patio doors from the living room and a little barn. It has electric heating and an attic that could be partly converted, subject to permissions. Asking €99,999, about €556/m².

rows.title: Two-storey 3-bedroom house with sea views near the beach in Varnavas, East Attica
rows.why_great: This two-storey maisonette was built in 1995 and sits in a quiet location suitable for families all year round. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a kitchen and a living room across two levels, with tiled floors. Features include sea views, aluminium frames with double glazing, awnings and surrounding space included in the ownership. The beach is 5 minutes away and Athens is 50 km distant. Asking €120,000, about €1,000/m².

rows.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with mountain views and roof terrace in Katsidoni, Crete
rows.why_great: This renovated house is fully furnished and spread over two levels. The ground floor has an open plan living area with kitchen, a bathroom and a bedroom, and the second floor has a living area and two bedrooms. Outside there is a roof terrace with views, a courtyard of about 15 m2 and a plot of 70 m2. The home has solar panels and a TV antenna, and it is 12 km from the sea, with village views. Asking €85,000, about €885/m².

rows.title: Detached 3-bedroom house with garden and mountain views in Zachloritika, Achaea
rows.why_great: Built in 2016, this detached house spans three levels with 132 m2 of living space, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. It sits on a plot of about 300 m2 with a garden and a private parking space. Features include a fireplace, air conditioning, solar water heating and electric heating, and the windows look out over the mountains. The beach is 2.5 km away and Patras is 49 km away. Asking €205,000, about €1,553/m².

rows.title: Two-level semi-detached villa with shared pool and mountain views in Asproulianos, Crete
rows.why_great: This two-level semi-detached villa has 66 m2 of living space, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a guest WC. Underfloor heating runs throughout, and the living room has a wood burner. A covered tiled terrace on the upper level overlooks the shared pool and has distant sea views, while the property also has a small garden and private covered parking. Georgioupolis sandy beach is 3 to 5 minutes away, and Chania airport is about 45 minutes' drive. Asking €185,000, about €2,803/m².

rows.title: Furnished 2-bedroom townhouse with garden and pool in Trinità d'Agultu e Vignola, Sardinia
rows.why_great: This fully furnished end-terraced house has two bedrooms, one with an en-suite bathroom, and two bathrooms in total. The living room includes a kitchenette and opens onto a veranda overlooking the garden and the granite rocks of Gallura. Both bedrooms have direct access to the backyard courtyard. The property includes a private parking space and use of a communal swimming pool. It is located in Costa Paradiso on the north coast of Gallura. Asking €199,000, about €2,341/m².

rows.title: 2-bedroom house with terrace and views in Sinarades, Corfu
rows.why_great: The house has three levels with 125 m2 of living space, two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and one bathroom. Both bedrooms are bright, and one opens onto its own balcony above the entrance terrace. The home keeps its original wooden features and has a ground floor cellar, plus a small yard shared with the neighbouring property. Views reach over village rooftops and greenery, and the beaches of Agios Gordios and Kontogialos are close by, with Corfu Town within easy reach. Asking €150,000, about €1,200/m².

rows.title: Farmhouse with pool, views and fireplace in Huércal-Overa, Almería
rows.why_great: This farmhouse has two bedrooms, one bathroom with a shower and 152 m2 of living space. The open-plan kitchen and living room has a fireplace, and a spacious covered terrace lies at the front. A private swimming pool sits beside the house on a completely flat, fenced plot with wide views over the landscape. Huércal-Overa is a 10-minute drive away, and the last 200 meters are on a well-maintained unpaved road. The home is connected to mains water and solar electricity. Asking €175,000, about €1,151/m².

rows.title: House with annexe and pool on walled plot in Albox, Almería
rows.why_great: The annexe has three bedrooms, a family bathroom and an open plan lounge and kitchen with a log burner and air conditioning. The main house has one bedroom with an ensuite, a fully fitted kitchen and a lounge with a log burner and air conditioning. The walled plot has a 5x3m pool with a terrace, fruit trees, a pump house and a storage shed. Views over the garden and pool, with Albox 10 minutes away, Taberno 5 minutes and Huércal-Overa 20 minutes. Asking €174,995, about €926/m².

rows.title: 2-bedroom stone farmhouse with barn and open views in Courbiac, Lot-et-Garonne
rows.why_great: This stone farmhouse dates from 1843 and offers 102 m2 of living space across two bedrooms, a kitchen of about 20 sqm with a fireplace. Outside there is an independent guest bedroom of about 16 sqm and a further room of about 11 sqm with toilet and shower room. An open barn of about 75 sqm and a plot of 3,625 sqm complete the property, which has open views and electric heating. It lies about 5 km from Montaigu-de-Quercy and Tournon d'Agenais. Asking €129,600, about €1,271/m².

rows.title: Bright 3-bedroom house with fireplaces and garden in Faye-la-Vineuse, Indre-et-Loire
rows.why_great: The house offers approximately 129 m² with three bedrooms, a very bright living and dining room with fireplaces, and a kitchen. It also has a small dining room opening onto a sunny courtyard, a cosy living room, a bathroom, a shower room, two separate WCs and a pantry. Outdoors there is a leafy garden with a small outbuilding. Heating is collective central heating. The house sits in a listed medieval village, 9 minutes from Richelieu. Asking €148,400, about €1,150/m².

rows.title: Character 4-bedroom house with terrace and countryside views in Champallement, Nièvre
rows.why_great: Character house with 204 m2 of living space, 4 bedrooms and 5 rooms, heated by gas-fired central heating. The living room has an open fireplace and ceiling beams, and opens onto a 30 m2 kitchen/dining room overlooking the church. A terrace of about 27 m2 offers panoramic views of the countryside and forest, and the plot includes a garden. It sits beside the church in Champallement, between Corbigny and Brinon-sur-Beuvron, less than 3 hours from Paris. Asking €165,000, about €809/m².

rows.title: 3-bedroom house with fireplace and mountain views in Abanilla, Murcia
rows.why_great: The house is in good structural condition and has 116 m2 of living space, three bedrooms and one bathroom with shower. The living-dining room has air conditioning, a wood-burning fireplace and electric heating, and the kitchen is equipped. Outdoors there is a sunny porch, two private patios, one with a removable pool, a garden and a garage. The property has mountain views and direct access from the house to a hiking trail. The village is a few minutes' walk away. Asking €150,000, about €1,293/m².
